en.title: Too Viral to Survive: Our Sub-Zero Login
en.premise: I fell in love with 'Sakura,' an anonymous beauty streaming online. But her true identity is Shiori, the plainest girl in school. The virtual space she manages, the 'Ice Castle,' is a sanctuary for venting the truths one can never tell anyone. As the cherry blossoms dance, we fall into a glitchy love, caught between the screen and reality.

zh.title: 爆紅到想死，我們的冰點登入
zh.premise: 我愛上了匿名美少女主播『Sakura』。然而，她的真實身份竟然是學校裡最不起眼的女生——栞。她經營的虛擬空間『冰之城』，是一個用來傾訴無法對任何人言說之真心話的避風港。在櫻花飛舞的季節，我們在螢幕與現實的縫隙之間，陷入了一場充滿Bug的戀情。
